blocks.text: Two crowd-favorite brands are coming together under one roof as Denny’s and Randy’s Donuts open their newest standalone store along Pablo Ocampo Extension this October 22. Bringing together Denny’s signature all-day dining and Randy’s iconic donuts, the new location promises guests more ways to enjoy good food, great coffee, and sulit deals any time of the day. All-Day Dining and Sulit Combos at Denny’s Known for its comforting American-style diner favorites, Denny’s makes every visit more satisfying with its All Day Combo, starting at just ₱375.
